look.why: A crisp botanical lime that harmonizes with its leaf-green camouflage while highlighting the yellow and turquoise bands.

size.measure: total length 45–60 cm in adult males (including coiled prehensile tail)

habitat.text: Mountainous slopes, valleys, and coastal plateaus of Yemen and southwestern Saudi Arabia.

diet.text: Insects such as crickets and locusts, supplemented with leaves, blossoms, and fruit for hydration.

facts.text: Its tall head crest (casque) channels morning dew droplets directly down toward the corners of its mouth.
Each turret-like eye moves independently, giving a full 360-degree view before locking onto prey.

id.habitat: Lereng pegunungan, lembah, dan dataran tinggi di Yaman serta Arab Saudi bagian barat daya.
id.diet: Serangga seperti jangkrik dan belalang, ditambah dedaunan, bunga, dan buah untuk sumber cairan.
facts: Jambul tinggi di kepalanya mengalirkan tetesan embun pagi langsung menuju sudut mulutnya.
Kedua mata kerucutnya bergerak terpisah untuk memantau 360 derajat sebelum mengunci mangsa.
